name: Honeywell Farenhyt IFP-2100ECS Fire Alarm Control Panel with ECS
short: Analog/addressable fire alarm panel with integrated Emergency Communication System.
description: The IFP-2100ECS (red) and IFP-2100ECSB (black) are intelligent analog/addressable fire alarm control panels combined with an Emergency Communication System, meeting UL 2572 mass notification requirements. One built-in SLC supports 159 IDP/SK sensors and 159 modules (or 127 Hochiki SD devices), expandable to 2,100 points per panel, with networking of up to 32 panels.
specs: 120 VAC (240 VAC HV model), 9 A accessory load

name: Honeywell Farenhyt IFP-2100 / RFP-2100 Fire Alarm Control Panel
short: Scalable analog/addressable fire alarm control panel, networkable to 32 sites.
description: The IFP-2100 (red) and IFP-2100B (black) are intelligent analog/addressable fire alarm control panels supporting 159 IDP/SK sensors plus 159 modules per loop, expandable to 2,100 points. The RFP-2100 is the same panel without a display, for networked systems with at least one IFP-2100. Includes eight Flexput circuits, a dual-line DACT with IP or optional cellular reporting, and detector sensitivity, drift compensation and pre-trouble maintenance alerts.
specs: 120 VAC / 240 VAC (HV), 9 A @ 24 VDC accessory load

name: Honeywell Farenhyt IFP-75 Series Fire Alarm Control Panel
short: Intelligent addressable fire panel with built-in SLC, Flexput circuits and communicator.
description: The IFP-75 Series is an intelligent addressable fire alarm control panel from Honeywell's Farenhyt line and a direct replacement for the IFP-50. One SLC supports 75 IDP/SK sensors and 75 modules (150 points) or 75 Hochiki SD devices, with networking of up to 32 panels over copper or fibre. A dual-technology (IP and POTS) DACT reports to a central station, with optional cellular reporting.

name: Honeywell Farenhyt RA-1000 Remote Annunciator
short: Remote annunciator to operate and program IFP-series fire alarm panels.
description: The RA-1000 remote annunciator matches the keypad and display of the IFP-1000 control panel and connects over the RS-485 system bus. It allows users to view alarms, supervisories and troubles, silence and reset the system, and start fire drills with a single key press, up to 6,000 ft from the panel.
specs: Alarm, supervisory, trouble, silence, AC power

name: Honeywell Farenhyt ECS-DUAL50W 50/100 W Dual Channel Amplifier
short: Intelligent 50/100 W voice evacuation amplifier with optional backup.
description: The ECS-DUAL50W (red) and ECS-DUAL50WB (black) are intelligent 50/100 W amplifiers for IFP ECS voice evacuation panels. Each has its own power supply with battery backup and eight speaker circuits, and is fully supervised by the main panel. Up to 16 amplifiers can be used per IFP-2100ECS system for a maximum of 1,600 W.
specs: 100 W single channel or 2 x 50 W dual channel

name: Honeywell Farenhyt RPS-1000 6 A Intelligent Distributed Power Module
short: Adds 6 A of power, six Flexput circuits and two relays to a Farenhyt system.
description: The RPS-1000 intelligent distributed power module adds 6.0 A of power, six Flexput I/O circuits and two Form C relays to a compatible Farenhyt addressable system. It connects over the RS-485 SBUS with up to 6,000 ft of additional wiring, is optically isolated for ground-loop and transient protection, and supports its own backup battery.
specs: RS-485 SBUS, Class A or B

name: Honeywell Farenhyt IDP-PHOTO-W Intelligent Photoelectric Smoke Detector
short: Intelligent plug-in photoelectric smoke detector with modern low-profile design.
description: The IDP-PHOTO-W Series intelligent plug-in smoke detectors combine a sleek contemporary design with an enhanced optical sensing chamber that responds to a wide range of combustion sources. Sensitivity is programmed and continuously monitored by the panel, and rotary decimal address switches give exact detector location. Variants include IDP-PHOTO-T with 57°C thermal sensing and IDP-PHOTO-R for duct housings.

name: Honeywell Farenhyt IDP-HEAT-W Intelligent Heat Detector
short: Intelligent thermal detector in fixed, rate-of-rise and high-temperature versions.
description: The IDP-HEAT-W Series intelligent thermal detectors offer advanced thermal technology for fast response in a sleek, contemporary housing. The series includes a 57°C (135°F) fixed-temperature model, a rate-of-rise model (8.3°C per minute) and an 88°C (190°F) high-temperature model, each individually addressable on a two-wire SLC.

name: Honeywell B200S / B200S-LF Intelligent Sounder Base
short: Addressable sounder base, including low-frequency 520 Hz version for sleeping areas.
description: The B200S sounder base adopts the address of the attached detector as a unique device type, so the panel can sound individual bases or groups. It supports System Sensor synchronisation for general evacuation. The B200S-LF low-frequency version produces the 520 Hz tone required by NFPA 72 for sleeping spaces.

name: Honeywell B501BH-3-S Sounder Base
short: Sounder base with built-in isolator for hotel rooms and similar spaces.
description: The B501BH-3 series sounder base replaces the standard detector base where a local sound alarm is needed, such as hotel rooms. DIP switches select Temporal-3 or continuous tones, high or low volume, loop or external 24 VDC power, and independent or synchronised mode. A built-in isolator protects the rest of the SLC if a short circuit occurs at the spot.

name: Honeywell Farenhyt IDP-PULL-SA / IDP-PULL-DA Addressable Pull Station
short: Addressable single-action and dual-action manual pull stations.
description: The IDP-PULL-SA (single action) and IDP-PULL-DA (dual action) addressable pull stations work with Honeywell Farenhyt panels. Installers can open the station without causing an alarm, and a dual-colour LED visible through the handle blinks green in normal operation and turns steady red on alarm.
specs: Blinking green normal, steady red alarm

name: System Sensor L-Series Indoor Horns, Strobes & Horn Strobes
short: Indoor LED horn strobes with field-selectable candela, tone and volume.
description: System Sensor L-Series and L-Series with LED notification appliances cut installation time with plug-in mounting plates, rotary switches for candela, tone and volume, and lower LED current draw. Available in standard and compact sizes for wall or ceiling use, and electrically compatible with legacy SpectrAlert devices.

name: System Sensor SpectrAlert Advance Mini-Horn MHR1 / MHW1
short: Compact 12/24 V mini-horn for hotels, motels and residential applications.
description: The SpectrAlert Advance MHR1 (red) and MHW1 (white) mini-horns provide primary and secondary signalling for fire and security applications. They operate at 12 or 24 V, mount on a single-gang back box, and are compatible with the MDL sync module.
specs: Single-gang back box, wall or ceiling

name: Honeywell RI/007C Remote Response Indicator
short: Remote LED indicator showing alarms from concealed detectors.
description: Honeywell RI/007C response indicators connect to conventional or addressable detectors that are hidden or hard to reach, giving quick visual indication of the source of an alarm. A rugged industrial design with a high-brightness, wide-angle LED.

name: Honeywell Farenhyt IDP-MINIMON Addressable Mini Monitor Module
short: Compact single-input monitor module for contact devices.
description: The IDP-MINIMON is a compact, lightweight addressable monitor module that interfaces contact devices such as waterflow switches and pull stations, and can monitor conventional 4-wire smoke detectors. Its small size allows it to sit in a single-gang box directly behind the monitored device.

name: Honeywell Farenhyt IDP-MONITOR-2 Addressable Dual Monitor Module
short: Dual-input monitor module, ideal for waterflow and tamper switches.
description: The IDP-MONITOR-2 addressable monitor module has two initiating circuits with unique addresses, supporting Class B supervised wiring. It is ideal for monitoring waterflow and tamper switches, and can also monitor conventional 4-wire smoke detectors.

name: Honeywell Farenhyt IDP-RELAY Addressable Relay Module
short: Addressable relay module with two Form C contacts.
description: The IDP-RELAY lets a Farenhyt fire alarm panel switch discrete contacts by command. It has two isolated sets of Form C contacts operating as a DPDT switch, suitable for almost any normally open or normally closed application, each with a unique SLC address.

name: Honeywell Farenhyt IDP-ISO Line Isolator Module
short: SLC loop isolator that keeps the loop working during a short circuit.
description: The IDP-ISO automatically opens when SLC line voltage drops below 4 V, isolating the devices between two isolators during a short so the rest of the loop keeps operating. Isolators should be placed between groups of no more than 25 devices.

name: System Sensor L-Series Outdoor Speakers & Speaker Strobes
short: Weatherproof outdoor speakers and LED speaker strobes, NEMA 4X / IP56.
description: System Sensor L-Series outdoor speakers and LED speaker strobes are weatherproof to NEMA 4X and IP56 and rated from -40°C to 66°C. Rotary switches set candela, speaker voltage (25 or 70.7 Vrms) and power taps, and units are compatible with legacy SpectrAlert devices.

name: System Sensor L-Series Indoor Speakers & Speaker Strobes
short: Indoor speakers and LED speaker strobes with selectable candela and power.
description: System Sensor L-Series speakers and LED speaker strobes share the common L-Series design with tamper-resistant construction, DVM test points and plug-in mounting plates. Rotary switches select candela, speaker voltage and power settings for wall or ceiling installations.

name: System Sensor L-Series Outdoor Horns, Strobes & Horn Strobes
short: Weatherproof outdoor horns and LED strobes for wall or ceiling use.
description: System Sensor L-Series outdoor horns, strobes and horn strobes are weatherproof to NEMA 4X and IP56 as standalone devices and rated from -40°C to 66°C. Rotary switches set candela, horn tone and volume, with tamper-resistant construction for wall or ceiling mounting.

name: Honeywell Farenhyt IFP-FFT Fire Fighters Telephone System
short: Fire fighter telephone control system with up to 72 zones.
description: The IFP-FFT provides supervision, annunciation and control for local and remote fire fighter telephone handsets. Each zone uses an IDP-MINIMON module and at least one FFT-FPJ phone jack, and the system expands to 72 zones with two FFT-24 expander boards.

name: Honeywell Farenhyt FFT-FPJ Fire Fighters Phone Jack
short: Remote fire fighter phone jack for the IFP-FFT system.
description: The FFT-FPJ remote phone jack gives fire fighters a quick connection to the IFP-FFT telephone system using an FFT-RHS handset. When a handset is plugged in, a monitor module lights the corresponding zone LED on the IFP-FFT.

name: Honeywell HON-CGW-MBB CLSS Gateway
short: Gateway connecting Honeywell fire panels to the CLSS cloud.
description: The CLSS Gateway connects a Honeywell fire panel or network to the Connected Life Safety Services (CLSS) cloud, reading the system's device inventory and sending it to CLSS. With an optional cellular module it can also act as a fire alarm communicator to a central station.

name: Honeywell CLSS Horizon Graphical Monitoring Software
short: Graphical on-premises and remote monitoring software for fire alarm systems.
description: CLSS Horizon gives personnel an intuitive graphical display to pinpoint, investigate and respond to alarm events, for single-site, multi-site or worldwide applications. Paired with the CLSS Gateway (HON-CGW-MBB), it runs on Honeywell's CLSS cloud platform.

name: Honeywell Morley-IAS Max Fire Alarm Panel
short: Multi-processor addressable fire panel with 7" colour touch screen.
description: Morley-IAS Max panels are multi-processor fire detection systems designed for industrial-grade resilience against electrical disturbances and false alarms. A 7" colour touch screen with virtual zone indicators allows full configuration without a PC, and an open protocol means any third party can maintain the system.

name: Honeywell Morley-IAS LT-32 / LT-159 Compact Analogue Panel
short: Compact analogue-addressable panel with 4.3" touch screen.
description: The LT-32 and LT-159 compact analogue-addressable control panels are quick to install and configure from the screen itself, using Honeywell's Advanced protocol for fast alarm detection. The LT-32 supports 32 addressable devices and the LT-159 up to 159.

name: Honeywell Morley-IAS DXc Connexion Fire Alarm Panel
short: 1, 2 and 4 loop networkable multi-protocol addressable fire panel.
description: The Morley-IAS DX Connexion range is a compact, feature-rich and economical analogue addressable panel for small to medium buildings. It is multi-protocol and can be networked up to 16 loops on a true peer-to-peer, fault-tolerant BS 5839-1 compliant network, programmed from the keypad or a Windows PC tool.

name: Honeywell Morley-IAS HM Series Optical Smoke Detector
short: Addressable optical smoke detector with advanced chamber design.
description: The HM/PSE optical smoke detector uses an advanced optical chamber proven to be less prone to false alarms from dust and insects. Smoothing filters and embedded algorithms improve resilience to unwanted alarms and speed up detection. Two red LEDs give 360° status indication.

name: Honeywell Morley-IAS HM Series Thermal Detector
short: Addressable heat detector, fixed 58°C or rate-of-rise.
description: The HM Series intelligent thermal sensors use an accurate thermistor circuit for early warning of developing fires. The HM/RHSE provides fixed 58°C plus rate-of-rise (Class A1R) sensing and the HM/FHSE provides fixed 58°C (Class A1S) sensing.

name: Honeywell Morley-IAS MI-LPB2-S2I Optical Beam Smoke Detector
short: Addressable reflective beam detector for large open spaces, 5 – 100 m.
description: The MI-LPB2-S2I is an addressable reflective linear optical beam smoke detector for large open spaces such as warehouses and atriums. A combined transmitter/receiver connects directly to the analogue loop and sends an infra-red beam to a reflector, with automatic drift compensation.

name: Honeywell Morley-IAS HM-MCP-GLASS Addressable Call Point
short: Addressable break-glass manual call point with test key.
description: The HM-MCP-GLASS addressable break-glass call point is addressed with a rotary decade switch, and a test key lowers the glass to give a full functional test. The panel-controlled LED blinks red when polled and turns steady red on fire.

name: Honeywell KAC Intelligent Wall Mount Sounder
short: Loop-powered 32-tone wall sounder, up to 97 dB(A).
description: KAC's wall mount sounder is a loop-powered device that alerts occupants with a choice of 32 tones and output levels. It twist-fits onto the System Sensor B501AP base and is controlled by on-board switches or the SS Advanced Protocol.

name: Honeywell KAC Intelligent Wall Mount Sounder Strobe
short: Loop-powered 32-tone sounder with EN 54-23 strobe.
description: The KAC wall mount sounder strobe combines a 32-tone sounder and a high-quality strobe in one loop-powered device, approved to EN 54-23. It twist-fits onto the B501AP base for flexible installation.

name: Honeywell KAC Intelligent Detector Base Sounder
short: Loop-powered 32-tone sounder base for SS detectors.
description: The KAC detector base sounder is a loop-powered 32-tone sounder that forms the base for System Sensor intelligent detectors, combining detection and alarm at one point.

name: Honeywell MI-DMMI / MI-DMM2I Addressable Input Module
short: Single or dual channel input module with built-in isolators.
description: The MI-DMMI (single) and MI-DMM2I (dual) addressable input modules mount in a wall box or on a DIN rail, with address switches and tri-colour status LEDs visible without removing the cover. Built-in short-circuit isolators protect the loop.

name: Honeywell MI-DCMO Addressable Output Module
short: Single channel addressable output module with Form C relay.
description: The MI-DCMO addressable output module mounts in a wall box or on a DIN rail, with visible address switches and tri-colour LEDs. It provides a Form C relay output and built-in short-circuit isolators.

name: Honeywell X-DCS2000 Digital Integrated System Manager
short: Core controller of the X-618 public address and voice alarm system.
description: The X-DCS2000 is the basic unit of the X-618 Public Address and Voice Alarm System. It integrates zone expansion, multiple audio sources, audio file storage, network audio, broadcasting, zone control, monitoring and fault diagnosis, and can broadcast four audio messages simultaneously with up to 255 priorities.

name: Honeywell X-DA4125EN 4 x 125 W Class-D Power Amplifier
short: Four channel 4 x 125 W Class-D amplifier with 24 VDC backup supply.
description: The X-DA4125EN is a high-efficiency Class-D power amplifier for the X-618 system. Audio transmission is fully digital for interference-free control, and the 24 VDC backup power supply conforms to international voice alarm standards. Automatic protection and fault detection with forced-air cooling.

name: Honeywell X-DA2250EN 2 x 250 W Class-D Power Amplifier
short: Two channel 2 x 250 W Class-D amplifier with 24 VDC backup supply.
description: The X-DA2250EN is a high-efficiency Class-D power amplifier for the X-618 system. Audio transmission is fully digital for interference-free control, and the 24 VDC backup power supply conforms to international voice alarm standards. Automatic protection and fault detection with forced-air cooling.

name: Honeywell X-DA1500EN 1 x 500 W Class-D Power Amplifier
short: One channel 1 x 500 W Class-D amplifier with 24 VDC backup supply.
description: The X-DA1500EN is a high-efficiency Class-D power amplifier for the X-618 system. Audio transmission is fully digital for interference-free control, and the 24 VDC backup power supply conforms to international voice alarm standards. Automatic protection and fault detection with forced-air cooling.

name: Honeywell X-NRI/EN Network Resource Interface
short: X-618 interface for fire alarm integration and audio extension.
description: The X-NRI/EN is the universal interface of X-618 for external control and audio extension. It provides 32 supervised dry-contact inputs and RS-485 links for fire panel integration, so fire alarm zones automatically trigger evacuation messages on the right voice alarm zones.

name: Honeywell HN-PTT Push-to-Talk Microphone
short: Dynamic push-to-talk microphone for X-DCS2000 and paging stations.
description: The HN-PTT push-to-talk microphone delivers clear voice reproduction with durable construction and a remote switching contact. Optional component of the X-DCS2000/EN and X-NPMR.

name: Honeywell X-MAP4P Digital Multi-Audio Player
short: Two-zone music player with USB, SD, Bluetooth and AM/FM.
description: The X-MAP4P digital multi-audio player has two independent USB/SD/Bluetooth and AM/FM line outputs, so it can play different music in two zones at once. Supports MP3, WMA, FLAC, APE, WAV and more, with 60 presets each for AM and FM.
specs: MP3, WMA, FLAC, APE, WAV, AAC

name: Honeywell L-VCP06A/EN 6 W Ceiling Loudspeaker
short: EN 54-24 ceiling speaker with flame-retardant dome.
description: A high-performance 6 W ceiling loudspeaker with broad frequency range and low distortion for intelligible voice. Its low-profile white design suits hotels, malls, conference rooms and cinemas, with a robust plastic housing and flame-retardant dome.

name: Honeywell L-VCM6B/EN 5" Metal Ceiling Loudspeaker
short: EN 54-24 metal ceiling speaker with fire dome.
description: The L-VCM6B/EN is a flush ceiling voice alarm loudspeaker for even sound distribution. A built-in protector ensures that fire damage to the speaker does not cause failure of the connected loudspeaker circuit. Available with or without capacitor.

name: Honeywell L-VWM06A/EN 6 W Metal Cabinet Loudspeaker
short: EN 54-24 wall cabinet speaker in robust metal enclosure.
description: The L-VWM06A/EN is a high-performance 6 W voice alarm cabinet loudspeaker with broad frequency response, low distortion and high sound pressure level for accurate evacuation messages. A robust metal enclosure suits all kinds of commercial interiors.

name: Honeywell L-VJM10A/EN 10 W Projection Loudspeaker
short: IP65 aluminium unidirectional projection speaker, indoor or outdoor.
description: The L-VJM10A/EN is a 10 W unidirectional projection loudspeaker for voice alarm use indoors or outdoors. The IP65 aluminium housing mounts on a ceiling or wall.

name: Honeywell X-NPMS Configurable Network Paging Station
short: 7" touch screen paging station with zoning and emergency broadcast.
description: The X-NPMS network paging station has a 7" TFT touch screen, configurable keys for zones and groups, manual emergency broadcast, monitoring, intercom and recording. Choose a gooseneck or PTT microphone; a built-in speaker allows audio monitoring.

name: Honeywell L-VOM40A/EN 40 W Outdoor Column Loudspeaker
short: IP66 aluminium column speaker with swivel bracket.
description: The L-VOM40A/EN is a 40 W voice alarm column loudspeaker for outdoor use. A robust aluminium housing withstands extreme environments, a universal swivel bracket allows easy angle adjustment, and it switches between 100 V and 70 V lines.

name: Honeywell HN-VC06/30/60/120 Volume Controller
short: Wall volume controller with emergency override relay.
description: HN-VC series volume controllers fit a standard 86 x 86 mm back box and work with 3-wire, 4-wire and 6-wire systems. A built-in 24 VDC forced relay overrides the volume setting for emergency announcements.

name: Teknoware TKX66xxC Central Battery System
short: Space-saving central battery units for mid to large premises.
description: TKX66C series central battery units supply a moderate number of luminaires and suit mid to large premises divided into independent regions. Luminaires are addressed over the power cables, so no separate data cabling is needed. Models from 8 to 24 circuits, single or three-phase.

name: Teknoware TKT7 Series Addressable Central Battery System
short: 230 V addressable central battery system with touch screen.
description: The TKT7 series is an efficient, flexible 230 V addressable central battery system for medium to large buildings. A bright touch screen, logical interface and automatic luminaire detection make commissioning fast, and it is compatible with all Teknoware 230 V addressable luminaires.

name: Teknoware TWX1251WK SLIMSPOT Emergency Light
short: Flush-mounted LED emergency light for open areas, 2 – 4 m.
description: TWX1251WK and TWX1251WKP are flush-mounted LED emergency lights for open areas, with optics that give a broad, uniform pattern. Suitable for 2 – 4 m mounting heights, with optional phase input (WKP).

name: Teknoware TWX1151WK SLIMSPOT Emergency Light
short: Metal-bodied flush LED emergency light for open areas.
description: TWX1151WK and TWX1151WKP are flush-mounted LED emergency lights with improved optics allowing longer spacing between luminaires. Metal construction, for 2 – 4 m mounting heights, with optional phase input.

name: Teknoware TWX1351WK SLIMSPOT Recessed Emergency Light
short: Compact recessed LED emergency light for 3 – 5 m ceilings.
description: TWX1351WK and TWX1351WKP are compact recessed LED emergency lights whose straight-line design blends into the ceiling. Optics avoid a disturbing bright centre point. Suitable for 3 – 5 m mounting heights.

name: Teknoware TWX4351WK SOLID Zone Midbay LED Emergency Light
short: IP65 dust- and water-proof emergency light for industrial areas and car parks.
description: TWX4351WK and TWX4351WKH are IP65 emergency lights for open areas, fully dust- and water-proof for industrial premises and parking halls. Centrally supplied versions are also suitable outdoors. Long-life LEDs, through-wiring and quick installation.

name: Teknoware TWX5051WK Linespot Corridor Emergency Light
short: Corridor emergency light with long, narrow beam for 2.5 – 10 m.
description: Linespot is designed for high corridors. Its optics give a long, narrow light pattern that illuminates escape routes efficiently and allows longer spacing between luminaires, for 2.5 – 10 m mounting heights. Polycarbonate body.

name: Escalux ESC0942L-S Emergency & Exit Bulkhead (Central Battery)
short: IP65 LED bulkhead for emergency or exit use, central battery supplied.
description: ESC0942L-S is an IP65 LED bulkhead with polycarbonate body and diffuser for wall, ceiling or surface mounting. It is a central-battery slave luminaire with a built-in Teknoware addressable module. Pictogram options available.
specs: Central battery supplied, built-in Teknoware addressable module

name: Escalux ESC0963L-S Recessed Emergency Downlight (Central Battery)
short: Ceiling recessed LED emergency downlight, central battery supplied.
description: ESC0963L-S is a ceiling-recessed LED emergency luminaire with polycarbonate body and aluminium lamp head. Central-battery slave luminaire with built-in Teknoware addressable module.
specs: Central battery supplied, built-in Teknoware addressable module

name: Teknoware TWX8051WK ESC80 LED Exit Sign
short: Slim LED exit light with evenly lit pictograms, three sizes.
description: TWX8051WK combines uniformly illuminated pictograms, low power consumption and a slender look. Available in three sizes (20, 26 and 30 m viewing distance), recessed or surface, single or double sided, with a separate mounting piece for fast installation.

name: Teknoware TWX9051WK ESC90 LED Exit Sign
short: Innovative LED exit light, 25 m viewing distance, wall or ceiling.
description: TWX9051WK is an LED exit light with uniformly illuminated pictograms, low power consumption and a slender appearance. Single or double sided, recessed or surface, on ceiling or wall; pictograms slide in for easy changes.
specs: Wall or ceiling, recessed or surface

name: Teknoware TWXB151WK COMBO Emergency & Exit Light
short: Combined emergency and exit light, IP40 or IP54.
description: TWXB151WK is a combination luminaire that works as both an emergency light and an exit sign, a cost-effective single fixture for a whole property. Available in IP40 and IP54 for internal and external areas, with a flame-retardant polycarbonate body.

name: Escalux ESC0911L-S AURA Exit Luminaire (Central Battery)
short: IP65 LED exit sign, 32 m viewing distance, central battery supplied.
description: ESC0911L-S is an IP65 exit luminaire with polycarbonate body and diffuser for ceiling mounting, with a 32 m viewing distance. Central-battery slave luminaire with built-in Teknoware addressable module; pictogram options available.
specs: Central battery supplied, built-in Teknoware addressable module

name: Escalux ESC0913L-S LIOR Exit Luminaire (Central Battery)
short: Edge-lit acrylic LED exit sign, central battery supplied.
description: ESC0913L-S is an exit luminaire with polycarbonate body and double-sided edge-lit acrylic legend, for wall, ceiling or surface mounting. Central-battery slave luminaire with built-in Teknoware addressable module.
specs: Central battery supplied, built-in Teknoware addressable module

name: Escalux IntelliPanel DALI Emergency Lighting Monitoring Panel
short: Touch panel for DALI emergency lighting testing and monitoring.
description: IntelliPanel is a DALI emergency lighting test and monitoring touch panel that works without a permanently connected PC. Two DALI circuits give 128 addresses, expandable to 1,024 luminaires with gateways, and multiple panels can be networked. Reports are viewed and printed with Intelli software, with remote access over Ethernet.

name: Helvar 405 DALI Repeater
short: Extends DALI line length to 600 m and adds 250 mA.
description: The 405 DALI Repeater extends the maximum DALI line length from 300 m to 600 m and provides an extra 250 mA of DALI current. It does not add addresses (the 64-address limit still applies). Several repeaters can be connected in parallel on the DALI-IN side.

name: Escalux ZIYA Self-Contained LED Recessed Downlight (DALI)
short: Slim self-contained recessed downlight, 180 lm, 3 h.
description: ZIYA is a slim, lightweight self-contained emergency LED downlight with smart charge technology and 3-hour duration, for lobbies, corridors, hotels and restaurants. Available for open area or escape route optics, in self-test or DALI-monitored versions.

name: Escalux AURA-Emergency Self-Contained Luminaire (DALI)
short: IP65 self-contained emergency luminaire, 325 lm.
description: AURA-Emergency is a self-contained LED emergency luminaire for warehouses and driveways, resistant to dust and water. Maintained or non-maintained operation, 3-hour duration, surface or recessed mounting.

name: Escalux SPOT High-Output Recessed Emergency Luminaire (DALI)
short: 550 lm recessed emergency spot for double-height areas.
description: SPOT is a high-output self-contained LED emergency luminaire that recesses into a 42 – 44 mm cut-out, suitable for double-height areas, with 3-hour battery backup and smart charge technology.

name: Escalux AURA-Exit Self-Contained Exit Sign (DALI)
short: IP65 self-contained exit sign, 21 m viewing distance.
description: AURA-Exit is a self-contained LED exit sign for wall or ceiling mounting, resistant to dust and water, with 21 m viewing distance and 3-hour duration. Up, down, left and right arrow pictograms available.

name: Escalux LIOR Self-Contained LED Exit Sign (DALI)
short: LED exit sign with 28 m viewing distance, wall/ceiling/recess.
description: LIOR is a high-performance self-contained LED exit sign for all public areas, with 28 m viewing distance, 3-hour duration and smart charge technology. Wall, ceiling or recess mounting, with single and double pictogram options.

name: Escalux AURA ESC0911L-M Standalone Emergency / Exit Luminaire
short: IP65 standalone luminaire for emergency or exit use, 190 lm.
description: AURA ESC0911L-M is a standalone self-contained luminaire in a fire-retardant ABS housing that works as an emergency light or exit sign, maintained or non-maintained. Wall, ceiling or surface mounting, TÜV certified.

name: Escalux LIOR ESC0913L-M Standalone Exit Luminaire
short: Edge-lit standalone exit sign, 30 m viewing distance.
description: LIOR ESC0913L-M is a standalone maintained exit luminaire with polycarbonate body and double-sided edge-lit acrylic legend. Wall, ceiling or recess mounting, with recess and flag brackets available. TÜV certified.

name: Escalux ZIYA ESC0963L-NM Standalone Recessed Emergency Light
short: Non-maintained recessed emergency downlight, 210 lm.
description: ZIYA ESC0963L-NM is a standalone non-maintained recessed emergency luminaire with polycarbonate body and lamp head, giving 210 lm for 3 hours. TÜV certified.

name: Uranus BMUR120 Fire Resistant Cable (PH120)
short: LPCB-certified PH120 screened fire resistant cable, LSZH sheath.
description: Uranus BMUR120 is a 300/500 V fire resistant cable with ceramic-forming EI2 insulation, overall Al-PET screen with tinned drain wire, and a halogen-free flame retardant sheath. It maintains circuit integrity to PH120 (EN 50200), BS 6387 CWZ and IEC 60331-21, for fire alarm and life-safety circuits. Available in 2, 3 and 4 cores from 1 to 2.5 mm².
specs: 2/3/4 core, 1 – 2.5 mm² (solid RE or stranded RM)
LSZH HFFR, red RAL 3000 or white RAL 9003
